name: Affine Pro
description: AFFiNE is a workspace for notes, docs, and whiteboards, and an alternative to Notion. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys AFFiNE as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Workspace for notes and docs, an alternative to Notion. Self-host Affine on Dokploy in minutes – no manual setup needed.
